description.value: Riley's Fish & Steak is a destination dining room in the heart of downtown Vancouver, operated by the Glowbal Restaurant Group and led by CEO Emad Yacoub. The menu is entirely chef-driven, centering on premium seafood — including an oyster bar and seafood towers — alongside top-tier steaks and chops, complemented by a curated wine room and signature cocktail program. The venue also features live music, private dining rooms, and a virtual tour, positioning it as an upscale evening-out rather than a casual mid-ride stop.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (9 spaces) at 75m; stands (10 spaces) at 79m; stands (10 spaces) at 81m. Total: 29 spaces.

Website branding renders the name as 'RILEYS' (no apostrophe) in display headings, though the copyright footer matches the OSM name 'Riley's Fish & Steak' — likely a stylistic choice, not a true discrepancy.
Business has a second location at 155 Wellington St W, Toronto, ON — ensure future enrichment records are not conflated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Riley's is a legitimate, active upscale restaurant that could serve as a destination meal for touring cyclists, but none of the required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence, and its high-end, reservation-focused format may not suit mid-ride stops. A human reviewer should confirm whether bike parking exists nearby and whether the venue is practically accessible to cyclists.
